KaggleRL

Space · jiyajahnavi/Kaggle-RL

Choose models and hyperparameters to train on real datasets (Iris, Titanic, Breast Cancer) and improve accuracy within a step budget.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal

Reward is based on change in measured accuracy, with penalties for stagnation, degradation and repetition and a bonus for exploiting good strategies.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

uvicorn server.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7860

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/jiyajahnavi/Kaggle-RL
cd Kaggle-RL

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.
